text: When Israel came forth from Egypt,the house of Jacob from an alien people,
Judah became God's sanctuary,Israel, God's domain. [AA]
t[1]The sea saw and fled;the Jordan turned back. [AB]
The mountains skipped like rams;the hills, like lambs. [AC]
Why was it, sea, that you fled?Jordan, that you turned back?
Mountains, that you skipped like rams?You hills, like lambs?
Tremble, earth, before the Lord, [AD]before the God of Jacob,
t[2]Who turned the rock into pools of water,flint into a flowing spring. [AE]
